_comment: Walking Ballista (2026-10-27, rebuilt after review). X = 0 (no mana: the only legal X), cast by a human line, onto a board of Heliod (devotion 1, not a creature), Soul Warden and Archangel of Thune. The 0/0 ENTERS, so Soul Warden gains 1; that gain triggers Heliod (one counter on a target) and Thune (a counter on EACH creature we control). The toughness SBA kills the Ballista before either trigger resolves (CR 704.5f / 704.3), so NEITHER may put a counter on it: without the DoomedEntrant skip, Thune's each-creature loop would hand the 0/0 a counter and it would SURVIVE as a 1/1 (the drain re-verifies toughness). Binding: the Ballista's death is in the history, and no '+1/+1 on Walking Ballista' (Heliod's narration) ever appears. Heliod's own default pick never prefers a 0-power entrant over the 1/1 Warden, so Thune's loop is the observable for the skip; Heliod is on the board so its trigger resolves in the same event.
